newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Bahia's Coelba base price set at 975.8 mln reais.
newsitem.headline: Bahia's Coelba base price set at 975.8 mln reais.

text.p: The Brazilian state of Bahia has set the minimum price for a 65.64 percent voting stake in its soon-to-be-privatized electrical power firm Coelba at 975.8 million reais, a spokesman for Bahia state government said.
The spokesman said tender documents for the selloff, scheduled for July 31, will be published Friday.
The company will be sold at a closed-envelope auction on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange.
In addition to the sale of a majority stake, some 5.5 percent of the company's capital will be offered to employees with a 50 percent discount, he said.
The spokesman also said about 10 groups have sought information about Coelba, including local and foreign investors from Portugal, United States, Chile and France.
Coelba, formally known as Companhia de Eletricidade da Bahia, posted a net profit of 4.3 million reais in the first quarter, against a 227.5 million reais loss in the same period of last year.
